biography: Stéphane Sarrazin, a 24-year-old Frenchman, is a rising star in the world of motorsport. Hailing from the small village of Alès, nestled in the Cévennes mountains, Stéphane's racing journey began unconventionally. Not through karting tracks like many of his peers, but rather by tearing down dusty mountain roads on his father's old Peugeot 205. It was here, navigating treacherous hairpin turns and unpredictable terrain, that he honed his innate car control and spatial awareness. A defining moment came at 18 when he entered a local hill climb race on a borrowed car and shocked everyone by setting the fastest time, beating seasoned professionals. This performance caught the eye of a Courage Racing scout, leading to a test drive and ultimately, a coveted spot within the Courage C60 Hybrid team. Now, with several podium finishes under his belt, Stéphane is steadily climbing the ranks, his ambition burning brighter with each race.
drivingStyle: Stéphane's driving style is best described as calculated aggression. He's not one for flamboyant overtakes or unnecessary risks. Instead, he meticulously studies the track, identifying optimal braking points and cornering lines. His tire management is exceptional, often allowing him to push harder in the closing stages of a race when others are struggling with grip. Under pressure, he remains remarkably composed, able to extract maximum performance from his car without making rash decisions. He's a strategist on wheels, constantly analyzing his opponents and adapting his approach to exploit their weaknesses.

rivalries.reason: A clash of egos. Marco, a veteran driver, sees Stéphane as an upstart threatening his position. There have been multiple on track incidents, with Bellini accusing Stéphane of reckless driving.

A fierce battle for the lead in the 2024 Le Mans 24 Hours. Their cars were evenly matched, leading to intense wheel-to-wheel racing and strategic gamesmanship. The rivalry continues to be a major topic amongst racing fans.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue socks on race day.
Refuses to eat any food containing tomatoes before a race.
Spends at least 30 minutes visualizing the first lap of the race, going over every corner in his mind.
famousQuote: Racing isn't just about speed, it's about control. Control of the car, control of your emotions, control of the race.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2025 Spa-Francorchamps 6 Hours race after a nail-biting finish, overtaking his rival Marco Bellini on the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2024 Nürburgring 1000km due to a sudden downpour, losing valuable championship points.
